description: This file implements the backend logic for saving and processing newsletter campaign data within the SuiteCRM platform, including handling campaign configuration, prospect lists, trackers, and navigation after saving.

methods.name: populate_wizard_bean_from_request
methods.description: Populates a given bean with request variables that match a specified prefix.

methods.name: process_subscriptions_from_request
methods.description: Creates or retrieves ProspectLists for subscription, unsubscription, and test lists based on request data and attaches them to a campaign.
